SELECT TO_CHAR(S.CREATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createAt, S.SHARE_NO AS shareNo, CAST(S.UID AS VARCHAR) AS uid, S.TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, S.TARGET_NO AS targetNo, S.USER_NO AS userNo, U.ID AS userId, U.NICKNAME AS userNickname, T.NAME AS topicName, SUBSTRING(CAST(F.CONTENT AS VARCHAR), 1, 80) AS fragmentContent FROM MB_SHARE S LEFT JOIN MB_USER U ON U.USER_NO = S.USER_NO LEFT JOIN MB_TOPIC T ON S.TARGET_TYPE = 0 AND T.TOPIC_NO = S.TARGET_NO LEFT JOIN MB_FRAGMENT F ON S.TARGET_TYPE = 1 AND F.FRAGMENT_NO = S.TARGET_NO WHERE TO_CHAR(S.CREATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = #{date} AND S.TARGET_TYPE IN (0, 1)
AND ( UPPER(U.ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(U.NICKNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(T.NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(CAST(F.CONTENT AS VARCHAR)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY S.SHARE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT 20 ROWS ONLY
